code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != 2)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall_cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(set(r for r,c in wall_cells)) == 1:
        wr = wall_cells[0][0]
        center = sum(r for r,c in obj)/len(obj)
        dr = 1 if wr > center else -1
        gap = min(abs(r-wr) for r,c in obj)-1
        dr *= gap
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r+dr][c] = grid[r][c]
        axis = int(center + 0.5)
        for c in range(w):
            if out[axis][c] == bg: out[axis][c] = 8
    else:
        wc = wall_cells[0][1]
        center = sum(c for r,c in obj)/len(obj)
        dc = 1 if wc > center else -1
        gap = min(abs(c-wc) for r,c in obj)-1
        dc *= gap
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c+dc] = grid[r][c]
        axis = int(center + 0.5)
        for r in range(h):
            if out[r][axis] == bg: out[r][axis] = 8
    return out
'''
